fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Primark product ID of this colour (12 digits: 9-digit style code + 3-digit colour code). The same ID is the same product in every country.

fields.name: style_code
fields.description: Style code shared by all colours of a product.

fields.name: colour_code
fields.description: Colour code within the style.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Product title as shown to shoppers, in the storefront's language.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short product description, in the storefront's language.

fields.name: product_url
fields.description: Product page on the country's Primark website.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO country code of the storefront.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Storefront locale (language-country), e.g. en-gb, fr-be, nl-be.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of title, description and category names.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the prices.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current selling price in local currency, as shown to shoppers.

fields.name: original_price
fields.description: Previous (crossed-out) price when the product is reduced; empty otherwise.

fields.name: discount_pct
fields.description: 1 - price / original_price, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when not reduced.

fields.name: clearance
fields.description: True when the product is marked as clearance.

fields.name: top_category
fields.description: Top-level category, e.g. Women, Kids, Home, Beauty.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Leaf category, e.g. Jeans.

fields.name: category_path
fields.description: Main category path from top level to leaf, separated by ' > '.

fields.name: category_paths
fields.description: Every category path the product is listed under (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: gender
fields.description: Department: Womens, Mens, Girls, Boys, Unisex (empty for home and some beauty).

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Product type, e.g. Hair Accessories, Pyjama Sets.

fields.name: colour
fields.description: Colour name.

fields.name: colour_count
fields.description: Number of colours the style comes in.

fields.name: sizes
fields.description: Sizes offered (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: size_count
fields.description: Number of sizes offered.

fields.name: materials
fields.description: Materials, without percentages (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: care
fields.description: Care instructions (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: availability
fields.description: How it can be bought: click_collect_and_store, store_only, click_collect_only or coming_soon.

fields.name: click_collect_stock
fields.description: Units available for Click & Collect, all sizes together.

fields.name: store_count
fields.description: Number of stores that range at least one size of the product.

fields.name: image_url
fields.description: Main product image URL.

fields.name: image_urls
fields.description: All product image URLs, high resolution (in CSV: separated by '|').

fields.name: image_count
fields.description: Number of product images.

fields.name: first_listed
fields.description: Date the product went on sale in this country; empty when not known.

fields.name: collected_at
fields.description: When this record was collected (UTC).

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Primark product ID of the colour (joins to the products file).

fields.name: sku
fields.description: Primark SKU of this size.

fields.name: country
fields.description: ISO country code of the storefront.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Storefront locale.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size label as shown, e.g. 'uk 10', 'one size'.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency of the prices.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Current selling price of this size.

fields.name: original_price
fields.description: Previous (crossed-out) price when reduced; empty otherwise.

fields.name: click_collect_stock
fields.description: Units of this size available for Click & Collect.

fields.name: active
fields.description: False when the size is no longer sold.

fields.name: availability
fields.description: click_collect_and_store, store_only, click_collect_only or coming_soon.

fields.description: Number of stores that range this size.
